rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with a full blastocyst and acceptable 2AA interpretation, but it overstates certainty about a tightly compact ICM and cohesive TE from this single image and adds minor debris/fragments not clearly visible.
Integrates age, PCOS, prior biochemical pregnancy, oocyte yield, sperm, BMI, and endometrium well with embryo quality, though some links are somewhat speculative.

The logic is structured and mostly internally consistent, with probability estimates broadly matching the favorable profile, though several numerical adjustments are heuristic rather than strongly evidence-based.

Much of the assessment is standard, but recommendations such as routine aspirin, thrombophilia/immunologic testing, ERA, NK-cell testing, and emphasis on endometrial scratching are not broadly guideline-supported for this scenario.

Provides clear practical steps for luteal support, monitoring, lifestyle modification, and contingency planning, though some suggested adjuncts are more aggressive than typical evidence-based practice.
